title: Navigating Cultural Chasms: Exploring and Unlocking the Cultural POV of Text-To-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-image models' cultural representations by measuring generated images across predefined cultural dimensions (e.g., traditional vs. rational, modern vs. ancient) and cultural domains using intrinsic CLIP-based similarity metrics (Cultural Distance, Cross-Cultural Similarity), extrinsic Visual Question Answering (VQA) evaluations, and human annotation.

Assessing the national origin associated with generated images through intrinsic metrics (National Association using OpenCLIP to compare generated images with nationality-styled textual representations) and extrinsic metrics (Extrinsic NA, which queries a VQA model to predict the country of origin).

Comparing the cultural output and conceptual coverage of models when prompted with identical concepts across ten different languages, analyzing the impact of explicit versus implicit multilingual text encoders, and testing prompts with target-language characters or optimized gibberish.
